geometryPlan.subtype: 连续双层键床立式钢琴

generationPromptZh: 立式钢琴有连续黑白键盘、完整琴体和四个承重脚。每个琴键下方都有至少两层连续键床，键床接入琴体承重框；黑白键仅占键床上表面，四脚各自接地。连续黑白键盘位于琴体前方，键床底托至少两层且接入承重框，四个琴脚以实心截面连接底部。。整体宽度约为前后长度的1.70倍，高度约为宽度的0.65倍，部件按功能位置围绕主体布置。。主体与附属部位采用近黑色、白色、棕木色的连续分区。正视显示主要功能部位，侧视显示前后厚度与连接，俯视显示横向布局和轮廓。。生成 detailed 彩色体素模型：整数网格48×48×48，X左右、Y向上、Z前后，最低真实接地点Y=0；750—1250个唯一非负坐标体素，单一六邻域连通，附件共享面连接。保留上述开口、空腔与部件数量，不加展示底板、背景、文字或无关连接杆。以语义部件连续配色；从原始参数几何统一XYZ重采样，并实测部件连接与表面可见性。琴键下方必须有至少两层连续实心底托，底托在原始模型内与琴体面连接；琴键黑白分区必须俯视可见，不允许悬空琴键、外露补撑或为拼接临时加杆。
generationPromptEn: An upright piano with a continuous black and white keyboard, a complete cabinet and four supporting legs. Every key rests on at least two continuous keybed layers joined to the cabinet frame; black and white keys occupy its exposed top surface, and all four legs reach the ground. A continuous black and white keyboard sits in front of the cabinet. Its solid keybed has at least two layers joined to the frame, and four legs attach through solid sections. Overall width is 1.70 times depth; height is 0.65 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous near black, white, brown color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout. Generate a detailed colored voxel object on a 48 cubed integer grid: X lateral, Y up, Z front/back, lowest actual contact at Y=0. Use 750 to 1250 unique nonnegative occupied cells in one six neighbor component; attach parts by shared faces. Preserve the stated openings, cavities and part counts. Omit display platforms, background, text and unrelated struts. Use continuous semantic color regions. Rebuild from original geometry at uniform XYZ density and measure attachment and exposed functional features. Each key must have at least two solid continuous supporting layers in the original geometry, face-connected to the cabinet frame. Both key colors must be exposed from above. Do not use unsupported keys, exterior repair props or temporary connecting rods.
